description: Walk into any store, and you will notice something different than you did a few years ago. More products are locked behind glass. More security guards are standing watch. More empty shelves where merchandise used to be.Organized retail crime is a growing problem across the country, and Tennessee is not immune. These are not petty shoplifters.
